summary: PROPOSED. D07 reviewed its 54 nodes: 25 kept, 25 rebalanced (D07 uses 'rebalance' for prerequisite repairs; 9 of them change factors), 8 relocated (4 also rebalanced) and 1 split, with 4 new nodes. (1) Coupling: seven medieval craft nodes (fulling mill, spinning wheel, treadle loom, roller gin, crank, verge escapement, pound lock) leave the Engineering subtree for the trunk, because they waited on the research stage (measured ~1532 CE) although artisans and millwrights spread them centuries earlier; all their prerequisites are trunk. (2) Causality: chronology ladders and analogy edges are replaced by knowledge actually needed - the water-supply ladder (qanat -> tunnel -> channel), the textile ladder (shuttle -> jenny -> frame -> mule -> power loom becomes wheel -> jenny / wheel + water -> frame; jenny + frame -> mule; shuttle + power -> loom), type founding (now the press's precondition, moved to the trunk with it - D05 accepted), interchangeable parts (no type-founding analogy), the arch (mudbrick, as its own anchor says), lime plaster (Natufian, before mudbrick), the verge escapement (water clock, not crank - D03's request), the pound lock (timber gates, not hull joinery), the skyscraper (structural iron, not reinforced concrete). (3) Alternative routes by material, crop or prime mover: wells (stone OR timber), irrigation (cereals OR root crops - D01's request), vaults (concrete OR brick OR ashlar), stone bridges (concrete OR ashlar), the power loom (water OR steam), desalination (distillation OR membranes). (4) Four new nodes: ashlar_masonry (split from stone_fortification; civil stone building no longer waits on military architecture), drawloom (the pattern loom Jacquard automated; silk's first dependant), structural_iron (iron bridges and frames, the real predecessor of the steel-frame skyscraper) and sanitary_engineering (sewerage and filtered water; infra.sewerage_system no longer hangs on germ theory and reinforced concrete). (5) Realization: only stone_dry's Built road class is realized today; water, sanitation, irrigation, fishing and textile-mill entities are T6.11 (M6) candidates with named consumer equations and blockers; castles and walls are M7; bridges, canals, harbours, lighthouses and skyscrapers are M10+.
